messages:
Maya (PM): Quick sync 30m: We need to lock scope for the Console observability rollout. Customers want visibility fast but ops can't absorb unbounded tracing. Proposing a tight MVP and a defined ramp plan.
Arjun (Eng): Propose minimal API surface: 2 dashboard templates (cost heatmap, errors by service), tracing hook that adds tenant_id + route, sample-store that keeps N traces per error type. Keep retention short.
Priya (SRE): Operational constraints: network egress and trace storage are the big risks. Suggest default sample_rate=0.5% and a per-tenant escalation token that requires support approval. Also an automated throttle when trace-burst > 2000/min.
Ben (Data): Cost modeling note: we can provide approximate per-tenant cost from aggregated logs (tokens, compute-ms, model unit price). Exact per-span billing needs schema changes; that's a follow-up (ETA 2 sprints). For launch we can show an "estimated" number with confidence band.
Zoe (Design): UX asks: show an attribution confidence indicator; simplify the cost UI to three cards: "Estimated spend", "Top routes", "Confidence". For traces, use a sampled trace viewer with link back to full trace only for elevated customers.
Nate (CS): Customers (AcmeHealth, FinTrack) will accept estimated numbers if we note the caveat. AcmeHealth asked for a one-click download of cost CSV for QBRs. Can we include that in the MVP?
Arjun (Eng): CSV export is cheap if we use the aggregated table Ben mentioned. I'll add an export endpoint. Implementation point: tenant_id tagging needs a tiny change in the request path middleware; I'll own it.
Priya (SRE): Rollout gating: feature flag + percentage rollout. Must include an auto-safety that reduces sampling to baseline if error rate or ingestion spikes. Add an alert to #oncall when quota > 70%.
Maya (PM): Draft launch acceptance criteria: 
- Dashboards: 2 templates rendering with synthetic and customer data 
- Tracing: tenant_id tagging in 1% default sample rate, sample viewer enabled behind flag 
- Cost: estimated per-tenant monthly and route, CSV export available 
- Errors: top-10 error types surfaced, N sampled traces per type 
- Ops: throttle & alerting in place + rollout plan to top-5 customers
Please ack or call out blocking risks.
Arjun (Eng): Ack from Eng. Blocker: the trace pipeline needs a small schema bump to carry tenant_id to the sampling stage; estimate 3 days.
Ben (Data): Acknowledged. I'll wire the aggregate table and add model_unit_cost column. Will attach a mapping doc. ETA EOD tomorrow.
Zoe (Design): Ack. I'll drop mocks for the dashboard cards and the confidence pill in this thread by noon.
Priya (SRE): Ack from SRE. Operational risk: if we enable per-tenant escalation widely we'll need a review flow. Recommend pilot with 5 customers only.
Nate (CS): I'll coordinate pilot customers and collect QBR export requirements.
Maya (PM): Decision: ship MVP with conservative defaults (sample_rate 1% -> corrected to 0.5% per SRE), two dashboards, CSV export, estimated per-tenant cost, and sampled trace viewer behind flag. Pilot rollout to 5 customers. Action owners: Arjun (tenant tag + endpoint) 3 days, Priya (alerts + throttle) 5 days, Ben (mapping + sample data) EOD, Zoe (mocks) noon, Nate (pilot customers + comms) EOD Friday.
Arjun (Eng): Will open PR and link to CI.
deploy-bot: build/ci-pipeline #512 started for branch feature/obs-tenant-tag (1747770125)
Maya (PM): Thanks team 30nd we'll reconvene after PR. If anything escalates, ping #eng-oncall and drop blockers here.
